label: sec:hecke-chi-closed-forms-chi-per-irrep-preamble
html: This sub-section assembles the \chi-character closed forms per Hecke irreducible representation at small partitions. We first derive the \chi_{V_3} closed form (the substrate-level prototype). We exhibit the cyclotomic closed forms for \chi per irrep with their substrate-flow data, and isolate the per-block Hopf-Jones absorption pattern that pins the \mathfrak{Q}_\beta c_k closed forms. The closing blocks specialise to \chi_{V_{111}} via sign substitution, derive \chi_{V_{21}} via the Hoefsmit matrix, and state the \phi_d SYT count conjecture.
